headline: Five Steps.
Start to Finish.
s3.sub: From request to completed service: ClutchD matches you with verified nearby providers in minutes — you approve the estimate before the wrench lifts, and track every step live.

steps.title: REQUEST
steps.body: Tap SOS or pick a calibrated service profile; outline mechanical malfunction indicators.

steps.title: MATCH
steps.body: Algorithmic proximity dispatch connects localized certified specialists by diagnostic tier.

steps.title: TRACK
steps.body: Watch arrival in sub-second telemetry mapping; continuous bidirectional audio/data link.

steps.title: FIXED
steps.body: Standardized roadside interventions with photographic diagnostic audit checkpoints.

steps.title: REVIEW
steps.body: One-tap automated ledger settlement, parts warranty logging, and technician evaluation.

Car owners.title: SOS button for real emergencies
Car owners.body: Instant telemetry relay bypassing traditional phone trees and dispatch queues with sub-second incident broadcast.

Garages.body: Job volume, revenue, and rating trends in one view — know what's driving the business.

Fleets.title: Monitor vehicles & health
Fleets.body: Every unit's systems in one live view — from battery to brakes, downtime becomes planned, not discovered.

Fleets.title: Schedule maintenance
Fleets.body: Per-vehicle service reminders keep the fleet ahead of breakdowns, not reacting to them.

Fleets.title: Manage drivers
Fleets.body: Raise and track service requests for any vehicle, with every job on the record.

Fleets.title: Predictive maintenance & analytics
